name: weblate-checks-action
description: GitHub Action that converts Weblate translation quality-check failures into a SARIF file for GitHub Code Scanning.
description_good_justification: README opens with a one-sentence description of what the action does and why. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: README covers quick start/usage; CONTRIBUTING.md covers how to get involved. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is on the OSI-approved license list.
license_location_justification: LICENSE file in the repo root. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/LICENSE
documentation_basics_justification: README covers quick start, inputs/outputs, severity mapping, and local usage. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/README.md
documentation_interface_justification: The action's interface is its inputs/outputs, documented in both action.yml and the README's Inputs/Outputs tables. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/action.yml
sites_https_justification: Project is hosted on GitHub (https only); the tool's own network client (_fetch) validates and requires an http(s) scheme before every request.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests support discussion.
english_justification: All documentation and code comments are in English.
repo_interim_justification: Interim versions are committed to git, not just tagged releases.
version_unique_justification: Each release gets a unique vX.Y.Z git tag.
version_semver_justification: Releases follow semver (see CONTRIBUTING.md § Releasing new versions). https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#releasing-new-versions
version_tags_justification: git tags (vX.Y.Z, plus a floating v1) identify releases.
release_notes_justification: GitHub Releases with generated notes, e.g. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/releases/tag/v1.0.4
release_notes_vulns_justification: No vulnerabilities have been reported or fixed yet (new project), so there's nothing to have documented in release notes so far.
report_responses_justification: No bug reports filed yet (new repo) — vacuously true; actively monitored by the maintainer.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests filed yet (new repo) — vacuously true.
report_archive_justification: GitHub issue tracker keeps a public, searchable archive. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub Security Advisories (private) is the primary channel, per SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging within 5 business days and a fix within 90 days.
build_justification: Pure Python stdlib script run directly by the interpreter — no compile/build step.
test_justification: pytest suite mocking all network calls. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/tests/test_weblate_checks_to_sarif.py
test_most_justification: 100% statement coverage on the main module, enforced via `--cov-fail-under=100` in both CI and the pre-push hook. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: ci.yml runs the full suite on every push and pull_request. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: Documented in CONTRIBUTING.md's Testing policy section and mechanically enforced: 100% statement coverage required via the CI status check and the local pre-push hook, both blocking. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#testing-policy
tests_are_added_justification: Same enforcement as test_policy — a change that doesn't add tests for new/changed functionality drops coverage below the enforced 100% floor and fails CI/pre-push.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md's Testing policy section states the requirement explicitly. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#testing-policy
warnings_justification: ruff (lint), mypy --strict, and bandit are all run as compiler/linter-style warning flags. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
warnings_fixed_justification: All three (ruff, mypy, bandit) are required CI steps — any warning blocks merge via the branch ruleset's required status check.
warnings_strict_justification: mypy runs with strict = true (pyproject.toml); bandit runs at -ll (medium+ severity); ruff uses its default modern rule set.
know_secure_design_justification: Evidenced by the project's own threat model in SECURITY.md's Scope section and the deliberate URL-scheme validation in _fetch (defense against SSRF via a malicious/misconfigured --weblate-url or an API-echoed web_url). https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/SECURITY.md
know_common_errors_justification: bandit, CodeQL, and zizmor are all run specifically to catch common vulnerability classes (injection, SSRF, unsafe deserialization, workflow injection); the maintainer authored the SSRF-specific scheme-validation guard in _fetch by hand, not just via tooling.
crypto_published_justification: The tool implements no cryptography of its own — network requests rely on Python's stdlib TLS handling; there's no custom crypto algorithm to publish.
crypto_call_justification: No cryptographic functionality is implemented or invoked beyond stdlib TLS for https:// requests.
crypto_floss_justification: No cryptographic functionality implemented or invoked.
crypto_keylength_justification: No cryptographic keys are generated or managed by this tool.
crypto_working_justification: No cryptographic functionality implemented or invoked.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No cryptographic functionality implemented or invoked.
crypto_pfs_justification: No persistent network sessions of its own to apply PFS to — relies on stdlib TLS defaults for the individual https:// requests it makes.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The tool stores no passwords. The Weblate API token is passed through as an input/env var and never written to disk by this tool.
crypto_random_justification: No security-sensitive randomness is used anywhere in the codebase (grepped: no use of the random module at all).
delivery_mitm_justification: All network access (Weblate API and scraped translate pages, plus the repo itself) is over https; _fetch validates the URL scheme is http(s) before every request.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Delivered via GitHub Releases over https, with the SBOM cryptographically signed via cosign (keyless/Sigstore) and SLSA provenance attested. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/.github/workflows/release-sign.yml
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No vulnerabilities have ever been publicly reported against this project (first release 2026-07-26) — vacuously true.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No vulnerabilities have ever been publicly reported against this project — vacuously true.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning is enabled by default on public repos; no credentials are committed — the Weblate API token is only ever read from an input/env var, never logged or written to the SARIF output.
static_analysis_justification: bandit, mypy --strict, zizmor, and CodeQL. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL and bandit both specifically target common vulnerability classes (injection, SSRF, unsafe deserialization, etc.).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: bandit/mypy/zizmor are required CI steps that block merge (via the branch ruleset's required status check); CodeQL findings go to the Security tab and are triaged.
static_analysis_often_justification: ci.yml (bandit/mypy/zizmor) runs on every push/PR; codeql.yml additionally runs on a weekly schedule.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Atheris fuzz harnesses run after every merge to main (light budget) plus a deeper weekly run. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/.github/workflows/fuzzing.yml
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Pure Python (memory-safe language) — no memory-unsafe code paths for tools like ASan/UBSan to apply to.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests and fuzz harnesses run under a plain (non `-O`-optimized) Python interpreter, so assertions are never stripped; the codebase itself doesn't rely on bare `assert` for validation (grepped: none present).
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: A fuzz crash uploads a SARIF result to the Security tab and fails the job; every finding is triaged and fixed or the corpus/harness adjusted before being considered resolved.
dco_justification: No Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off is required on commits/PRs.
governance_justification: GOVERNANCE.md documents the solo-maintainer model and decision-making process. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
access_continuity_justification: No documented continuity plan (e.g. a backup admin/co-maintainer) if the primary maintainer becomes unavailable.
bus_factor_justification: Single maintainer; the project would stall without them.
documentation_roadmap_justification: BACKLOG.md exists but is a short punch-list of one-time admin/deferred items, not a forward-looking feature roadmap.
documentation_security_justification: SECURITY.md plus AGENTS.md's "Error handling contract" and "_fetch is the sole network chokepoint" sections describe the security-relevant design.
documentation_current_justification: Docs are updated in the same change as the code/behavior they describe.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: No user-facing UI/website beyond the GitHub repo itself.
internationalization_justification: A CLI/Action with no UI strings of its own to translate (ironic, given the tool scans *other* projects' translations).
maintenance_or_update_justification: Only one major version (v1) has ever existed — nothing to retroactively maintain yet.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability has ever been reported, so no reporter has needed crediting yet.
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging within 5 business days and a fix within 90 days.
coding_standards_justification: AGENTS.md's "Conventions" section (strict mypy, ruff lint/format, Conventional Commits, SHA-pinned Actions).
coding_standards_enforced_justification: ruff + mypy --strict are required CI steps and pre-push hook checks.
installation_common_justification: Installed the standard GitHub Actions way — `uses: e2jk/weblate-checks-action@v1` in a workflow, per the README quick start.
installation_standard_variables_justific: GitHub Actions have no installation-time variables like DESTDIR to honor.
installation_development_quick_justifica: 3-command venv setup in CONTRIBUTING.md's Development setup section.
external_dependencies_justification: Runtime: zero (Python stdlib only). Dev/test: requirements-dev.txt and requirements-fuzz.txt, both hash-pinned.
interfaces_current_justification: Dependabot keeps dev/test dependencies current weekly; the runtime script itself has no third-party dependencies to go stale.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: ci.yml runs the full suite on every push/PR.
regression_tests_added50_justification: No bugs have been reported/fixed yet (new project) — vacuously true; the enforced 100% coverage floor means any future fix would need a covering test anyway.
test_policy_mandated_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md's Testing policy section, mechanically enforced (not just suggested) via the CI/pre-push coverage gate. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#testing-policy
implement_secure_design_justification: AGENTS.md documents the specific secure-design decisions in prose (e.g. "_fetch is the sole network chokepoint" — single point of scheme validation rather than scattered checks).
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: No cryptographic functionality implemented or invoked.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The Weblate API token is Weblate's credential, not ours — passed through via input/env var, never persisted by this tool.
crypto_used_network_justification: All network access (Weblate API, scraped translate pages) is https-only.
crypto_tls12_justification: Relies on Python's default SSL context via urllib, which enforces a modern minimum TLS version.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: urllib.request.urlopen with the default SSL context verifies certificates; no verify-disabling code anywhere.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: TLS handshake and certificate verification complete before the Authorization header (token) is ever sent, per standard TLS/HTTP layering.
signed_releases_justification: SBOM signed with cosign (keyless/Sigstore) and SLSA provenance attested, attached to every release. https://github.com/e2jk/weblate-checks-action/blob/main/.github/workflows/release-sign.yml
version_tags_signed_justification: Release tags are annotated (`git tag -a`) but not GPG/Sigstore-signed.
input_validation_justification: E.g. _fetch's URL-scheme allowlist, _parse_locations's strict isdecimal() check (deliberately not isdigit(), which accepts unparseable Unicode digit variants).
hardening_justification: Not a network-facing service — no HTTP responses of its own to add security headers to.
assurance_case_justification: No formal threat model / assurance case document, despite the informal security reasoning captured in SECURITY.md and AGENTS.md.
contributors_unassociated_justification: All contributions so far are from a single individual/organization.
copyright_per_file_justification: SPDX-FileCopyrightText headers on every source file (weblate_checks_to_sarif.py, tests/, fuzz/, .github/scripts/, scripts/ship.sh).
license_per_file_justification: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT headers on every source file, same set as copyright_per_file.
code_review_standards_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md's "Landing changes on main" section documents what review means for external PRs (human review before merge) vs. the owner's own commits (auto-merge by design, since the author already reviewed it by writing it).
two_person_review_justification: By design, the maintainer's own commits auto-merge without a second reviewer (see CONTRIBUTING.md) — deliberately not two-person review.
test_branch_coverage80_justification: 100% branch coverage too (measured with `pytest --cov-branch`: 52/52 branches, 0 partial).
security_review_justification: No independent/external security review has been performed.
